strategy: First guarded mini-release aligned to the current strongest operational shortlist: exact variants, non-provisional community data, resolved merchant mappings and current direct purchase destinations are already verified. Selection order is operational priority, not a fragrance quality ranking.
write_policy: All-or-nothing. Do not partially promote this manifest. Use a dry-run first; write only when all five products pass every promotion gate.

mapping_readiness.note: Every Release Batch 01 product has at least two resolved merchant mapping rows and a current verified direct purchase destination. Live promotion remains blocked until approved product images exist.

write_guard_reason: Release 01 is the first operational batch. A write is still refused unless every product-level approved-image and staging QA gate passes; current purchase destinations are already verified for all five products.
